theme_archetype.parent_view: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) + Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Dark Theme. Rationale: Must feel like a trusted, professional, high-end wealth management tool to convince parents and investors.
theme_archetype.child_view: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) - Light Theme. Rationale: Must feel like a top-tier dopamine-rich mobile puzzle game (e.g., Toon Blast, Royal Match) to keep kids engaged.

parent_view.rules: Use tracking-tight on headings, tabular-nums for financial data. Keep scales moderate and dense.

child_view.rules: Use heavy weights (font-black, font-bold), playful bounce, high readability, and large text scales.

spacing_layout.global_demo_structure: A split-screen presentation view: Left side (60%) Parent Dashboard Desktop view, Right side (40%) Child View strictly contained inside a mobile phone mockup frame. This enables simultaneous live interaction for the grant pitch.

parent_dashboard.grid: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-12 with varied spans)
parent_dashboard.spacing: p-6 to p-8, tight inner gaps (gap-4)
parent_dashboard.alignment: Strict geometric alignment, left-aligned data, dense and compact.

child_app.container: max-w-[375px] h-[800px] mx-auto rounded-[3rem] border-[12px] border-slate-900 overflow-hidden relative bg-pink-50 shadow-2xl
child_app.buttons: Chunky blocks, full width, massive padding.

parent_view.cards: 1px solid border-white/10, bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-md, subtle inner shadow.
parent_view.charts: Recharts with neon strokes (Cyan/Emerald) on deep dark backgrounds. Hide grid lines.
parent_view.ui_library: Shadcn heavily customized for dark mode.

child_view.cards: White background, rounded-3xl, thick shadow-sm (e.g. shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]).
child_view.buttons: Tactile gaming buttons: solid bright color, distinct bottom shadow (e.g. shadow-[0_6px_0_#BE123C]), translating down on click (active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none).
child_view.ui_library: Custom HTML/Tailwind ONLY. Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards here.

parent_view.data_ticks: Flash green/red background slightly on price update. Highlight table rows briefly.

child_view.mascot: Floating continuous animation (translate-y up and down).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-pane demo (Split Screen: Left Parent, Right Child in phone frame) so grant reviewers can see the real-time interaction simultaneously.
Implement WebSocket or React Context to share state instantly: when Kid buys 'Apple Candy', Parent sees pending approval; when Parent approves, Kid gets confetti.
Parent View: Use Shadcn components extensively but restyle them to fit the dark Jewel/Swiss theme. STRICTLY no 'Inter' font.
Child View: Build custom CSS/Tailwind components. Make buttons 'chunky' with bottom box-shadows that compress on :active to mimic physical game buttons.
Integrate 'react-confetti' for the kid's buy celebration.
Implement an AI Story block that appears in the Kid view after buying, explaining the stock in 6-year-old language (e.g., 'Apple is building new magic phones!').
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, input, and interactive card.
